hooks.name: no-puts-statements
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); CONTENT=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.content // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.rb$ ]] && printf '%s' "$CONTENT" | grep -qE '(^|[^a-zA-Z_])(puts|p) '; then echo 'Warning: puts/p statements should be replaced with proper logging' >&2; exit 2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: rubocop-autocorrect
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.rb$ ]]; then if command -v rubocop >/dev/null 2>&1; then rubocop -A "$FILE" >&2; elif command -v bundle >/dev/null 2>&1 && bundle show rubocop >/dev/null 2>&1; then bundle exec rubocop -A "$FILE" >&2; fi; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: log-notifications
hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); mkdir -p ~/.gemini; echo "Gemini CLI notification: $(date)" >> ~/.gemini/notifications.log; echo '{}'

hooks.name: brakeman
hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; if [[ -f Gemfile ]] && command -v brakeman >/dev/null 2>&1; then brakeman --quiet --no-pager >&2; fi; echo '{}'

hooks.name: bundler-audit
hooks.command: cat >/dev/null; if [[ -f Gemfile ]] && command -v bundle >/dev/null 2>&1 && bundle show bundler-audit >/dev/null 2>&1; then bundle audit >&2; fi; echo '{}'
